strings.task.veltrava.blanket.title: A blanket for Frau Brunner
strings.task.veltrava.blanket.summary: Frau Brunner ran to the fire in her nightdress and is freezing by the fire engine. She would never ask for anything.
strings.task.veltrava.blanket.hint.ask: Talk to Frau Brunner by the fire engine again.
strings.task.veltrava.blanket.hint.locker: The fire engine carries blankets – in the equipment locker behind the cab.
strings.task.veltrava.blanket.hint.return: Take the blanket to Frau Brunner.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.ask.title: The slippers
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.ask.text: Frau Brunner is freezing in a coat over her nightdress and won’t take anything from the fire brigade. There are blankets on the fire engine.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.ask.l1: I’m all right. It’s only the shock. And the slippers.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.ask.l2: Your hands are blue, Frau Brunner.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.ask.l3: The fire brigade needs everything it has tonight. I don’t want to take anything from anyone.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.ask.l4: There are blankets on the fire engine. They’re freezing there too, and for no reason.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.ask.l5: And you? You’re black up to the eyes.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.ask.l6: Soot doesn’t keep you warm. I’ll be right back.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.locker.tex: In the equipment locker behind the cab: branch pipes, couplings, an axe and, on top, neatly folded, six grey wool blankets stamped ‘Veltrava Fire Brigade’. On the inside of the frame, a list: ‘To be taken only against signature’. I write: one wool blanket, 02:25, Morozov, for Frau Brunner. The engineer at the pump looks over, nods and goes on turning the valve.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.return.tex: Frau Brunner has a fire-brigade blanket round her shoulders, signed for by Morozov. She is staying until the fire is out.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.return.l1: A blanket? For me? Herr Morozov, that belongs to the fire brigade.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.return.l2: I signed for it. One wool blanket, two twenty-five. They’ll get it back.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.return.l3: You wrote a receipt. For a blanket. Tonight of all nights.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.return.l4: Where I work, nothing moves without a waybill. Not even a blanket.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.return.l5: For thirty years I typed lists. Names, wagons, crates. Not one of them ever said ‘for Frau Brunner’.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.return.l6: Now one does. At the fire brigade. That counts too.
strings.explore.veltrava.task.blanket.return.l7: Then I’ll stay until they’ve put it out. Somebody has to write down what’s left.
